title: 稳定身份，不授权新的目的地
coreProposition: Correctly attributed persistent identity does not grant entry or execution rights at a changed destination.
articleSynopsis: Two OpenAI implementations distinguish stable graph identity from destination-sensitive readmission. Safe restoration separately establishes identity, continuity, destination compatibility and current execution permission; prior external effects still need reconciliation.
concreteScene: An identity card remains attached to a destination folder whose separate lock is closed.
causalChain: Presenting identity reaches a local reader but does not automatically open the destination.
titlePromise: Identity and destination admission remain visibly separate.
readerProblem: Assuming successfully restored identity permits execution in any workspace.
visibleResult: The amber destination lock remains closed
materials: cobalt optical glass, silver edging, amber glass lock
palette: cobalt blue, white, silver, small amber accent
